source.knownIngressDefect: The requested alpha and exact 1024px grid were returned as a 1254px RGB image with a baked light checkerboard and uneven row bands. Raw generated bytes are preserved; deterministic preparation keys the matte and fits whole silhouettes inside safe runtime cells.

preparation.operation: Key both baked neutral checkerboard values at native resolution, decontaminate only the two-pixel perimeter, retain interior stone and colored lights, remove disconnected crop-edge artifacts, and fit the sixteen silhouettes into 244px safe envelopes with a common 250px baseline in 256px cells.

review.intendedUse: dark-ground structure cutouts with readable material edges
review.notes: Dark-ground atlas inspection confirms sixteen complete objects, preserved warm/cyan light, and removal of the rejected white weeds and outlines. Formal acceptance requires the composed-screen and independent review workflow.
